001: Excuse me, does this bus go to downtown?
Yes, it does, ma'am. You can get on.
That's great! How much is the fare?
It's five reais and twenty centavos. Payment is by card or phone.
Perfect. I'll tap my card here.
Go ahead. There's a free seat in the back.
002: Do you know where the stop for bus one twenty-seven is?
Yes, I do. It's on the other side of the square, near the pharmacy.
And how often does it come?
It usually comes every fifteen minutes, but today it's running a bit late.
Oh, I see. Then I'll wait over there on the bench.
Good idea. When it arrives, I'll let you know.
003: Sir, does the subway stop at Central Station?
Yes, it does. It's the next station.
Good thing, because I'm in a hurry.
It's only a two-minute ride. You'll get there in no time.
What a relief! Thanks for the info.
You're welcome. Have a nice day!
004: Do you usually go to work by train or by bus?
I usually go by train, because it's faster.
And does the train usually come packed at this time?
Really packed, especially at eight in the morning. But I catch the seven thirty one.
Good strategy. I'm still trying to get used to the traffic.
You'll get used to it over time. After that, you won't even want to drive anymore.
005: Excuse me, where do I buy the subway ticket?
Over there at the ticket booth, or at the self-service machines.
Do I need a card, or can I just buy a single ticket?
If you're going to use it more than once, it's worth buying the card. It's rechargeable.
Good tip. I'll buy the card then.
Great. The minimum top-up is ten reais.
006: The taxi is taking too long. Do you think the traffic is bad?
It probably is. At this hour, the city gets really backed up.
Maybe it's better to take the subway then.
Yeah, the subway is more reliable. The station is a five-minute walk from here.
Let's go! I'd rather arrive late than not arrive at all.
Exactly. Let's walk to the station.
007: Excuse me, does this train stop at University Station?
Yes, it does. It's three stops from here.
How long does it take, roughly?
About ten minutes. It's super quick.
Perfect. And after the station, is it far to the college?
No, the exit is right across from the main gate.
008: Do you know if the bus line to the airport comes by here?
Yes, it does. The stop is right there on the corner of the avenue.
And what time is the last bus?
The last one leaves the bus station at eleven at night.
Good thing there's still time. Thank you!
No problem. Have a great trip!
009: What do you think about going to the park by bike?
I love the idea! But do you think the route is safe?
There's a bike lane that goes all the way to the park entrance.
Then it's settled. Let's go by bike.
Deal. Don't forget to bring water.
Don't worry. I'll bring my little bottle.
010: Can you tell me if this bus goes by the mall?
Yes, it does. But you'll need to get off at the hospital stop.
Oh, is it far from the mall entrance?
No, it's only two blocks on foot.
Perfect. Thank you so much for your help.
You're welcome. Pay attention to the name of the stop so you don't miss it.
